To lock your phone when performing a gesture, and to open Recents via gesture, CyberHome requires accessibility access.

CyberHome doesn't watch any user action, though the privilege to do so is required for all accessibility services. CyberHome discards any event sent by the system.

In order to lock your phone, or to open Recents, CyberHome uses the performGlobalAction Accessibility service.
To access shortcuts and additional features, set CyberHome as your default launcher
At a Glance can be manually added to the home screen by placing the CyberHome widget
To use Double-Tap to Sleep, set CyberHome as a device admin app. Tap \"Open settings\", then tap \"Activate this device admin app.\"

To use Double-Tap to Sleep, turn on the CyberHome accessibility service. Tap \"Open settings\", select \"CyberHome\" and turn on \"Use CyberHome.\"\n\nCyberHome uses Accessibility\'s `performGlobalAction` method to perform this action. This is a sensitive permission that allows monitoring other apps. However, CyberHome is not configured for that functionality and receives no events.

To use Open Recents, turn on the CyberHome accessibility service. Tap \"Open settings\", select \"CyberHome\" and turn on \"Use CyberHome.\"\n\nCyberHome uses Accessibility\'s `performGlobalAction` method to perform this action. This is a sensitive permission that allows monitoring other apps. However, CyberHome is not configured for that functionality and receives no events.
These settings will be ignored as CyberHome isn\'t set as the Recents provider
To search for contacts, grant contacts and phone permissions to CyberHome
To search your files, grant storage permissions to CyberHome
